comments.author: @Jae-Lv
comments.text: I love the channel!  The narration is well-written and the footage beautiful in every video.  However, the background music needs to go.  I’m no director/producer but it’s unnecessary and distracting.

replies.author: @truehorizons66
replies.text: Thank you so much for the kind words and for watching our videos! We’re really glad you enjoy the narration and visuals. Your point about the background music is completely understandable, and we’ll keep it in mind as we work on future documentaries.
